✨ claude-seo | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide automated, in-depth SEO audits and actionable recommendations within the Claude Code environment, helping users improve their website's search engine performance.
✨ Key Features: • Comprehensive SEO analysis (technical, E-E-A-T, schema, GEO, local, e-commerce, international) • 25 sub-skills and 18 specialist agents for parallel execution • Prioritized action plans with testable recommendations
📖 Summary: Claude SEO is an open-source plugin for Claude Code that performs comprehensive SEO analysis. It leverages 25 sub-skills and 18 specialist agents to cover a wide range of SEO aspects, providing prioritized, actionable recommendations grounded in primary-source guidance.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 gobackup | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating scheduled backups of databases and files to cloud storage for application servers.
✨ Key Features: • No dependencies • Multiple Databases source support • Multiple Storage type support • Archive paths or files into a tar • Split large backup file into multiple parts
📖 Summary: GoBackup is a Go-based CLI tool designed for application servers to automate the backup of databases and files. It securely stores these backups in various cloud storage services with scheduled execution and optional encryption and compression.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 stealth-browser-mcp | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enable AI agents and automated scripts to interact with websites that employ sophisticated anti-bot measures, such as Cloudflare, by providing an undetectable browser automation solution.
✨ Key Features: • Bypasses anti-bot systems and Cloudflare challenges • AI-driven network hook generation • Pixel-perfect UI cloning via chat commands • Utilizes nodriver and Chrome DevTools Protocol
📖 Summary: Stealth Browser MCP is a Python library designed for advanced browser automation, specifically engineered to bypass anti-bot systems and CAPTCHAs. It leverages AI to automate network requests and replicate user interfaces with high fidelity, enabling seamless web scraping and interaction with protected websites.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source
